photos.name: finished-boule-in-hand
photos.summary: Finished sourdough boule on a wire cooling rack, held up by hand to show scale. Deep golden crust with a bold cross score that opened wide, revealing a blistered ear and flour-dusted surface.

photos.name: finished-boule-leaf-score
photos.summary: Finished sourdough boule cooling on a wire rack, featuring a decorative leaf score pattern on a flour-dusted crust. The ear opened cleanly along the main score line with even golden browning.

photos.name: starter-on-scale
photos.summary: Active sourdough starter weighed in a glass mixing bowl on a digital kitchen scale reading 204g, showing visible bubbles and a loose consistency indicating readiness.

photos.name: two-loaves-crumb-shot
photos.summary: Both finished loaves side by side -- the leaf-scored boule on a wire rack in the foreground, and the second smaller loaf cut into quarters on a cutting board behind it, showing an open, airy crumb with even hole structure.
